theme: job spawn prep NICE yield + SHQUOTE/SHUNQUOTE cmd plate

weaknesses.title: NICE is process-scoped — lost across cubalc re-execs
weaknesses.detail: yield then gate in separate runs sees original nice. Agents assume durable host priority like CHMOD. Same class as UMASK.

weaknesses.title: Double SHQUOTE nests — no idempotent quote mode
weaknesses.detail: SHQUOTE of already-quoted string re-wraps (double_same=0). Agents that quote twice corrupt SPAWN lines. No SHQUOTE_IF needed.

weaknesses.title: Cannot lower nice without privilege — restore soft-fail
weaknesses.detail: After yield, restore to lower value fails for unprivileged; only root can drop nice. No NICE_CAN_LOWER probe.

weaknesses.title: Empty string ARG collapsed to missing by BLANK
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_ARG1='' makes quote exit needs-string; cannot quote empty to '' via empty ARG without sentinel. Language BLANK treats empty as absent.
weaknesses.repro: quote ARG1 empty → EXIT needs string

weaknesses.title: SHUNQUOTE pass-through of unquoted raw is silent
weaknesses.detail: UNQUOTE raw → raw OK=1. Agents cannot tell was-quoted vs never-quoted without STARTS/ENDS ' checks.

weaknesses.title: HAS on quoted strings always hits quote chars
weaknesses.detail: HAS 'hello' ' → 1 always. False friends when searching for apostrophe content.

workarounds: Co-locate NICE set with SPAWN in same process
Never SHQUOTE twice; check STARTS ' before re-quote
Expect restore fail when lowering nice unprivileged
Use sentinel token for empty quote body
language_gaps: Empty ARG vs missing ARG distinction
issues_faced: cross-run nice loss and double-quote documented
empty ARG blank trap on quote
selftest 270/270; no language fix this iter
